title: The Border Incident
description: Two Tyvaren military aircraft violated Veltrian airspace at the Gravenmark Pass. Colonel Dusek held fire. Now you must decide what message to send back.

title: The Architect's Question
description: Jonas's deadline is approaching. He hasn't pressed — that's not his way. But you can feel the question hanging in every silence.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora's photocopy of the 1947 newspaper is still on her desk. She won't stop looking at it just because you're busy.

title: Budget Allocation — Defense Supplement
description: The border incident has military implications — and fiscal ones. Dusek's requested readiness adjustments require funding.

title: Cabinet Session — Border Response
description: Full cabinet convenes to coordinate the government's unified response to the Tyvaren provocation. Brenner will present the military assessment.
